scope.operation: Classify malformed negative graph-link targets as known projection gaps.
scope.evidence: DRW_AcisBodyGraphLink documents -1 as the null target; DRW_AcisNode::refs uses the same convention, and the rooted pointer-row validator accepts only raw -1 for null or an exact nonnegative in-range target.
scope.invariant: Every retained graph-link target is -1 (null) or nonnegative; values below -1 are invalid.
scope.semanticLimit: Projection consistency only; this does not establish source completeness, native ACIS semantics, B-rep validity, or consumer acceptance.
